# LegendWidget

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Display a color scale legend overlay on the visualization.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/legend-widget",
  "type": "LegendWidgetOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/legend-widget').par.colorRamp` (an input) and `op('/legend-widget').out.widget` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.colorRamp`, `out.widget`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `colorRamp` | `ColorRampField` |  |

| `minValue` | `NumberField` | `0` |
| `maxValue` | `NumberField` | `1` |
| `placement` | `StringLiteralField` | `"bottom-right"` |
| `steps` | `NumberField` | `12` |
| `scale` | `NumberField` | `1` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->
